query: Russia Ministry of Defence daily claims of Ukrainian drones destroyed overnight, nightly figures reported in July 2026. List specific overnight ('over the past night') drone interception numbers claimed by Russian MoD for each night from early July through late July 2026, as reported by Kyiv Independent, Ukrainska Pravda, Reuters.
answer:
## Summary

I compiled Russia's Ministry of Defence near-daily "over the past night" Ukrainian drone interception claims for July 2026. **Key scope note: today is July 15, 2026, so only nights through ~July 12–13 have occurred and been reported — figures for late July (16–31) don't yet exist and can't be reported without forecasting.**

### Night-by-night Russian MoD overnight drone claims (as reported by Reuters, Kyiv Independent, Kyiv Post, Ukrainska Pravda, TASS, Sputnik, Xinhua):

| Night | MoD claimed drones downed | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Jul 3–4 | 494 UAVs (500+ total targets); 389 in narrower overnight tally | +10 Flamingo missiles, 9 HIMARS |
| Jul 5–6 | 613 (of 625 launched) | "Pre-NATO-summit" swarm |
| Jul 6–7 | 452 | Largest raid on Moscow in 2 years (430+ per Sobyanin) |
| Jul 7–8 | 415 | Over regions + Black/Azov Seas |
| Jul 8–9 | 73 | |
| Jul 9–10 | 376 | 10+ regions incl. Moscow oblast |
| Jul 10–11 | 178 | |
| Jul 11–12 | 349 | |
| Jul 12–13 | 342 | Fatal Moscow-region strike same night |

Plus the widely-cited **926 drones "in the past day"** (~July 12–13) — a broader 24-hour all-fronts total, not a single overnight figure.

### Key caveats
- These are **unverified Russian claims**; Ukraine doesn't confirm them.
- "Overnight" tallies (typically 20:00–08:00 Moscow time) count only **fixed-wing/long-range drones over Russian territory**; short-range/quadcopter drones near the front are reported separately, and window definitions vary day-to-day (explaining why 494/500+ and 926 are much larger than typical overnight counts).

All figures, dates, and 16 sources are captured in the structured output.
key_facts: Russia's MoD posts near-daily Telegram bulletins on 'over the past night' Ukrainian drone interceptions, relayed by TASS, Sputnik, Reuters, Kyiv Independent, Kyiv Post, Ukrainska Pravda; figures are unverified Russian claims.
Night of July 3-4, 2026: MoD claimed 500+ aerial targets, incl. 494 long-range UAVs, 10 Flamingo cruise missiles, 9 HIMARS; a separate Russian morning tally cited 389 drones overnight.
Night of July 5-6, 2026: Ukraine launched 625 attack drones; MoD claimed 613 aerial targets shot down over Russian regions (framed as thwarted pre-NATO-summit offensive).
Night of July 6-7, 2026: MoD claimed at least 452 Ukrainian drones intercepted across 16 regions; Moscow mayor said 430+ targeted Moscow region (largest raid on Moscow in two years).
Night of July 7-8, 2026: MoD claimed 415 Ukrainian drones shot down overnight over Russian regions, Black Sea and Sea of Azov.
Night of July 8-9, 2026: MoD claimed 73 Ukrainian fixed-wing drones intercepted overnight.
Night of July 9-10, 2026: MoD claimed 376 Ukrainian drones intercepted overnight across 10+ regions including Moscow oblast.
Night of July 10-11, 2026: MoD claimed 178 Ukrainian fixed-wing drones destroyed overnight (20:00 Moscow Jul 10 to 08:00 Jul 11).
Night of July 11-12, 2026: MoD claimed 349 Ukrainian UAVs intercepted overnight over ~12 regions plus Azov/Black Seas.
Night of July 12-13, 2026: MoD claimed 342 Ukrainian fixed-wing drones intercepted overnight.
Around July 12-13, MoD's broader 24-hour total was 926 drones 'in the past day' (all fronts), not a single overnight figure.
MoD claimed ~5,000 drones (4,975 aircraft-type UAVs) destroyed in one week (reported July 10); ~4,000 the prior week; and 63,933 in H1 2026.
As of the 2026-07-15 research date, nights after ~July 12-13 had not yet occurred; late-July (Jul 16-31) figures do not yet exist.
MoD 'overnight' counts cover only fixed-wing/long-range drones over Russian territory and adjacent seas; short-range/quadcopter drones near the front are reported separately.
